title: DTS 温度传感原理图册

routes.name: 单端拉曼 OTDR
routes.summary: 从一端发射脉冲、接收两条拉曼谱带；用参考温度区与差分衰减校正获得沿纤温度。
routes.sum_en: Launch and receive from one end; calibrate the Raman ratio using known-temperature references and differential attenuation.

steps.label: B0 → B1 · 发射 / Launch
steps.equation: B1(t) = sqrt(P0) a(t);  z = c (t - t0) / (2 ng)
steps.zh: 脉冲包络 a(t) 发射到光纤。往返时间定位 z；ng 是群折射率，t0 是系统延迟。
steps.en: The launched pulse envelope a(t) defines the interrogation. Round-trip delay gives z; ng is the group index and t0 the system delay.

steps.label: B2S / B2AS · 散射 / Scattering
steps.zh: nR = 1/[exp(γ/T)-1] 是声子占据数；γ = h ΔνR/kB，单位 K。A 包括相应通道的累计损耗。
steps.en: nR = 1/[exp(γ/T)-1] is the phonon occupation; γ = h ΔνR/kB in kelvin. A includes the cumulative channel loss.

steps.label: iS / iAS · 接收 / Detection
steps.equation: iS = RS PS + bS;  iAS = RAS PAS + bAS
steps.zh: 先扣除背景、暗信号并校正增益；光学 WDM 分离 Stokes 与 anti-Stokes，不能用电滤波代替。
steps.en: Subtract background/dark signals and calibrate channel gains. An optical WDM separates Stokes and anti-Stokes; electrical filtering cannot replace it.

steps.label: R → T · 解调 / Calibration
steps.equation: D(z,t) = ln[PS/PAS] + C(t) - AΔ(z);  T(z,t) = γ/D(z,t)
steps.zh: AΔ(z)=∫0^z[αAS(s)-αS(s)]ds。这里采用 Hausner 的标定符号；C 吸收通道效率差，必须由已知温度区标定。
steps.en: AΔ(z)=∫0^z[αAS(s)-αS(s)]ds. This is the Hausner calibration convention; C absorbs channel-efficiency differences and needs known-temperature references.

steps.label: Δz / σT · 分辨率 / Resolution
steps.equation: Δzpulse ≈ c τp/(2 ng);  Δzsample = c ΔtADC/(2 ng)
steps.zh: 脉宽尺度与采样点间距不同；实际空间响应还受探测器带宽、滤波和编码影响。弱 anti-Stokes 通道通常主导温度不确定性。
steps.en: Pulse scale differs from sample spacing. Detector bandwidth, filtering, and coding also affect spatial response. Weak anti-Stokes returns often dominate temperature uncertainty.

routes.limits: 熔接、弯曲及连接器会产生局部差分损耗；单端标定的损耗模型不能自动覆盖所有变化。
routes.limits_en: Splices, bends, and connectors create local differential losses; a single-ended loss model cannot automatically cover every change.

routes.name: 双端拉曼 OTDR
routes.observable: 双向强度比与差分衰减
routes.summary: 光纤两端接入光开关，交替从 A、B 两端测量；先统一物理坐标，再联合标定。
routes.sum_en: Connect both ends through an optical switch and interrogate alternately; map both traces to the same physical coordinate before joint calibration.

steps.label: B0 → B1 · 发射 / Launch
steps.equation: B1(t) = sqrt(P0) a(t);  z = c (t - t0) / (2 ng)
steps.zh: 脉冲包络 a(t) 发射到光纤。往返时间定位 z；ng 是群折射率，t0 是系统延迟。
steps.en: The launched pulse envelope a(t) defines the interrogation. Round-trip delay gives z; ng is the group index and t0 the system delay.

steps.label: B2S / B2AS · 散射 / Scattering
steps.zh: nR = 1/[exp(γ/T)-1] 是声子占据数；γ = h ΔνR/kB，单位 K。A 包括相应通道的累计损耗。
steps.en: nR = 1/[exp(γ/T)-1] is the phonon occupation; γ = h ΔνR/kB in kelvin. A includes the cumulative channel loss.

steps.label: iS / iAS · 接收 / Detection
steps.equation: iS = RS PS + bS;  iAS = RAS PAS + bAS
steps.zh: 先扣除背景、暗信号并校正增益；光学 WDM 分离 Stokes 与 anti-Stokes，不能用电滤波代替。
steps.en: Subtract background/dark signals and calibrate channel gains. An optical WDM separates Stokes and anti-Stokes; electrical filtering cannot replace it.

steps.label: A / B → z · 双端坐标 / Coordinates
steps.zh: B 端迹线需要反转到 A 端的 z 坐标；两端时延零点和有效纤长 L 分别标定。
steps.en: Reverse the B-end trace into the A-end coordinate; calibrate both delay origins and the effective fiber length L.

steps.label: DA / DB · 联合标定 / Joint calibration
steps.zh: 若传递互易、两端增益已校准且温度在轮询间稳定，则两式平均得到 γ/T+AΔ(0,L)/2；仍需参考温度区确定常数。
steps.en: For reciprocal transfer, calibrated end gains, and temperature stable during switching, averaging yields γ/T+AΔ(0,L)/2; reference temperatures are still needed.

steps.label: 校正边界 / Limits of correction
steps.zh: 双端校正针对沿程差分损耗，不会消除未知时间变化、非互易增益、饱和或参考温区误差。
steps.en: Double-ended correction addresses distributed differential loss; it cannot remove unknown temporal changes, non-reciprocal gains, saturation, or bad references.

routes.limits: 需要两端可达及稳定的双向坐标映射；两端交替测量的时间错位对快速过程尤其重要。
routes.limits_en: Both ends must be accessible and spatially aligned; interleaved acquisitions can alias rapid thermal changes.

routes.name: 编码拉曼 OTDR
routes.observable: 解码后的两通道脉冲响应
routes.summary: 保持拉曼测温原理，用多脉冲编码累积能量，再恢复单脉冲响应。
routes.sum_en: Keep the Raman thermometry principle, accumulate energy with coded pulses, and recover the single-pulse response.

steps.label: a → c · 编码发射 / Coded launch
steps.zh: ck 是实际非负发射码；双极性数学码需通过互补或分组采集实现，不能直接发射负光功率。
steps.en: ck is a realizable non-negative optical code. Bipolar mathematical codes require complementary/grouped acquisitions; negative optical power is impossible.

steps.label: yS / yAS · 线性测量 / Linear acquisition
steps.zh: C 是由实际发射序列构造的编码矩阵；两通道共享时序，但噪声和增益不同。
steps.en: C is the matrix of actual launched codes; the two channels share timing but have different noise and gains.

steps.label: y → h · 解码 / Decode
steps.equation: ĥj = D yj;  D C ≈ I
steps.zh: D 是匹配码族的解码算子；先解码两条通道，再扣背景、求比值和标定温度。
steps.en: D is the decoder for the selected code family. Decode both channels before background subtraction, ratio formation, and thermometry.

steps.label: R → T · 解调 / Calibration
steps.equation: D(z,t) = ln[PS/PAS] + C(t) - AΔ(z);  T(z,t) = γ/D(z,t)
steps.zh: AΔ(z)=∫0^z[αAS(s)-αS(s)]ds。这里采用 Hausner 的标定符号；C 吸收通道效率差，必须由已知温度区标定。
steps.en: AΔ(z)=∫0^z[αAS(s)-αS(s)]ds. This is the Hausner calibration convention; C absorbs channel-efficiency differences and needs known-temperature references.

steps.label: Δz / σT · 分辨率 / Resolution
steps.equation: Δzpulse ≈ c τp/(2 ng);  Δzsample = c ΔtADC/(2 ng)
steps.zh: 脉宽尺度与采样点间距不同；实际空间响应还受探测器带宽、滤波和编码影响。弱 anti-Stokes 通道通常主导温度不确定性。
steps.en: Pulse scale differs from sample spacing. Detector bandwidth, filtering, and coding also affect spatial response. Weak anti-Stokes returns often dominate temperature uncertainty.

routes.limits: 编码增益依赖码长、噪声、脉冲非线性与解码条件；不能把码长直接当作空间分辨率或保证的信噪比提升。
routes.limits_en: Coding benefit depends on code length, noise, pulse nonlinearity, and decoder conditions; code length does not itself set spatial resolution or guarantee SNR gain.

routes.name: 光子计数拉曼 OTDR
routes.observable: Stokes / anti-Stokes 到达时间直方图
routes.summary: 以单光子探测器和时间标记器替代模拟接收链；保留拉曼比值与标定关系。
routes.sum_en: Replace the analog receiver with single-photon detectors and time tagging; retain Raman-ratio calibration.

steps.label: 发射 → 计数 / Launch to counts
steps.equation: NS(z), NAS(z) = counts in calibrated delay bins
steps.zh: 以同步触发建立到达时间直方图；先扣暗计数与背景。时间箱宽是采样间距，不自动等于分辨率。
steps.en: Build delay histograms against the launch trigger; subtract dark/background counts. Bin width sets sampling, not automatically spatial resolution.

steps.label: 计数 → 功率代理 / Counts to power proxy
steps.zh: ηj 包括光路透过率与探测效率，tm 是累计时间；需在线性低计数区使用，检查死时间与堆积。
steps.en: ηj includes optical throughput and detector efficiency; tm is integration time. Operate in the low-count linear regime and check dead time and pile-up.

steps.label: R → T · 解调 / Calibration
steps.equation: D(z,t) = ln[PS/PAS] + C(t) - AΔ(z);  T(z,t) = γ/D(z,t)
steps.zh: AΔ(z)=∫0^z[αAS(s)-αS(s)]ds。这里采用 Hausner 的标定符号；C 吸收通道效率差，必须由已知温度区标定。
steps.en: AΔ(z)=∫0^z[αAS(s)-αS(s)]ds. This is the Hausner calibration convention; C absorbs channel-efficiency differences and needs known-temperature references.

steps.label: 统计不确定性 / Counting uncertainty
steps.zh: 仅适用于独立泊松计数、背景可忽略、标定参数固定。实际还需传播背景、效率及损耗标定误差。
steps.en: Applies only to independent Poisson counts, negligible background, and fixed calibration. Real uncertainty also includes background, efficiency, and attenuation calibration.

steps.label: 时间尺度 / Timing scales
steps.equation: Δzpulse ≈ c τp/(2ng);  Δzbin = c Δtbin/(2ng)
steps.zh: 脉宽尺度与直方图箱间距不同；实际响应还受探测器抖动、光纤色散和计数处理影响。
steps.en: Pulse scale differs from histogram bin spacing. Detector jitter, fiber dispersion, and counting processing also affect the response.

routes.limits: SNSPD 与 SPAD 不是同一器件；示意图以单光子接收功能为概括，引用实例采用需要低温系统的 SNSPD。
routes.limits_en: SNSPD and SPAD are different detectors. The functional schematic represents single-photon reception; the cited experiment used cryogenic SNSPDs.

routes.name: 布里渊 BOTDA 测温
routes.summary: 通过泵浦-探测频差扫描获得局部增益谱；在应变已知或隔离时反演温度。
routes.sum_en: Scan pump-probe detuning to obtain local gain spectra; infer temperature only when strain is known or isolated.

steps.label: B0 → Bp / Bs · 光源 / Source
steps.equation: Bp(t)=sqrt(Pp) a(t) exp(i 2πνp t);  Bs(t)=sqrt(Ps) exp(i 2πνs t)
steps.zh: 同源泵浦与探测支路分开。探测光经单边带调制及选边带滤波，下移到 νs=νp-Δν；两束在光纤中反向传播。
steps.en: Pump and probe are derived from the same source. Single-sideband modulation and sideband selection create νs=νp-Δν; the waves counter-propagate.

steps.label: G(z,Δν) · 增益谱 / Gain spectrum
steps.zh: 弱增益、近稳态条件下用洛伦兹线型拟合局部谱。强泵浦耗尽、脉冲瞬态及谱重叠会破坏简化模型。
steps.en: Fit a local Lorentzian in the weak-gain, near-steady regime. Pump depletion, pulse transients, and overlapping spectra can invalidate this approximation.

steps.label: i(t,Δν) → νB(z) · 定位 / Localization
steps.zh: 按触发时延定位，并扫描泵浦与探测频差 Δν；每个 z 拟合 Brillouin frequency shift，简称 BFS。
steps.en: Locate by trigger delay and scan the pump-probe detuning Δν. Fit the Brillouin frequency shift (BFS) at each position.

steps.label: ΔνB · 温度与应变 / Cross-sensitivity
steps.zh: 相对于参考状态的小变化模型。Cε 的单位为 Hz/单位应变（或 MHz/με），CT 为 Hz/K；不能混用单位或把单一频移当作两个未知量。
steps.en: A small-change model relative to a reference. Cε is in Hz per unit strain (or MHz/με), CT in Hz/K. One shift cannot identify two unknowns.

steps.label: 解耦 / Compensation
steps.zh: 应变测量需要独立温度信息；测温需要已知或隔离的光纤应变。光缆热膨胀与约束会改变有效标定。
steps.en: Strain sensing requires independent temperature information; thermometry requires known or isolated fiber strain. Cable expansion and constraint alter the effective calibration.

routes.limits: BFS 同时对温度与应变敏感；松套管不能保证所有工况下完全无应变。还须校准实际光缆热响应。
routes.limits_en: BFS responds to temperature and strain. A loose tube does not guarantee zero strain under every condition; actual cable thermal response needs calibration.

routes.name: 瑞利 OFDR 相对测温
routes.observable: 相对参考状态的局部谱移
routes.obs_en: Local spectral shift relative to a reference
routes.summary: 用扫频干涉和局部瑞利指纹相关测量温度变化；已知参考温度及应变后才可恢复温度。
routes.sum_en: Use swept interferometry and local fingerprint correlation for temperature change; known reference temperature and strain are needed to recover temperature.

steps.label: B0 → B1 / BL · 分光 / Split
steps.equation: ν(t)=ν0+κt;  B1 ∝ exp[i2π∫ν(t)dt];  BL is the reference field
steps.zh: 扫频光分为测量与参考支路；辅助不等臂 MZI 提供扫频时钟。κ 为实际光频扫描速率。
steps.en: Split the swept source into measurement and reference branches. An auxiliary unequal-arm MZI supplies the sweep clock; κ is the actual optical-frequency sweep rate.

steps.label: B2 + BL → i · 拍频 / Beat
steps.zh: 回波与参考光相干混频。τrel 是相对参考支路的延迟，需要零点标定，不能默认全部距离从光源开始。
steps.en: Mix the return with the reference. τrel is the delay relative to that arm; calibrate the distance origin rather than assuming it begins at the laser.

steps.label: i → r(z) · 空间变换 / Spatial transform
steps.equation: z-zref = c fb/(2 ng κ);  Δzideal ≈ c/(2 ng Bν)
steps.zh: 按实际光频重采样后作傅里叶变换。Bν 是光频扫描带宽；上述理想分辨率不等于应变标距。
steps.en: Resample on the measured optical-frequency grid before Fourier transformation. Bν is the optical scan bandwidth; ideal reflectometric resolution differs from the strain gauge length.

steps.label: r0 / r1 → q · 指纹相关 / Fingerprint correlation
steps.zh: 在相同窗口内比较参考与当前瑞利指纹；δν 是当前谱相对参考的有符号光频移。通常拉伸导致红移 δν<0，因此 q>0；须按实际相关实现核对符号。
steps.en: Compare reference and current Rayleigh fingerprints in matching windows. δν is the signed current-minus-reference optical-frequency shift. Tension usually gives a red shift δν<0, hence q>0; verify the sign in the actual correlation implementation.

steps.label: q → Δε / ΔT · 解耦 / Compensation
steps.zh: Kε、KT 按此符号约定实测标定；普通硅纤中通常为正。温度和应变同时变化时需第二个独立观测。
steps.en: Calibrate Kε and KT under this sign convention; they are usually positive for ordinary silica fiber. Simultaneous temperature and strain changes require a second independent observation.

routes.limits: 不是免标定的绝对温度计；大谱移、相干衰落和扫频期间状态变化会使相关失效。
routes.limits_en: This is not calibration-free absolute thermometry. Large shifts, fading, and state changes during a sweep can defeat correlation.

components.role_en: Separate Stokes/anti-Stokes bands and reject strong Rayleigh/pump leakage.
components.note: 需按激光波长配置两条拉曼谱带；普通 1550 nm 带通滤波器不能替代。
components.note_en: Match both Raman bands to the laser; an ordinary 1550 nm bandpass is not a substitute.

components.name: 双通道模拟弱光接收

components.role_en: Detect both Raman bands and sample synchronously.
components.note: 示意的是接收功能；Si / InGaAs、增益、带宽与谱带匹配须另行选型。
components.note_en: Functional illustration only; select Si/InGaAs, gain, bandwidth, and spectral coverage separately.

components.name: 双端测量光开关
components.role: 在 A、B 两个光纤端口之间轮询发射与回波接收。
components.role_en: Alternate launch and reception between fiber ends A and B.
components.note: 记录切换时间及两端损耗；不是两个端口同时发射。
components.note_en: Record switching time and end losses; this is sequential interrogation.

components.name: 已知温度参考区
components.role: 提供 γ、C 和差分衰减等标定量所需的已知温度区段。
components.role_en: Provide known-temperature sections to calibrate γ, C, and attenuation.
components.note: 参考区长度、温度均匀性、热平衡与独立验证区都需要检查。
components.note_en: Check section length, uniformity, equilibrium, and independent validation.

components.name: 独立参考温度计
components.role: 测量参考区温度，并记录其准确度和响应时间。
components.role_en: Measure reference temperature with documented accuracy and response.
components.note: DTS 与参考温度计时间需同步；不能用 DTS 自身输出作为独立校准真值。
components.note_en: Synchronize timing; DTS output cannot serve as its own independent calibration truth.

components.name: 单光子探测接收模块
components.role: 把弱拉曼光转为离散计数事件。
components.role_en: Convert weak Raman photons into count events.
components.note: 两种探测器实现不同；本文引文使用 SNSPD，需低温系统。此图为功能示意。
components.note_en: The detector technologies differ; the cited SNSPD experiment needs cryogenic cooling. This is a functional illustration.

components.name: 时间相关计数 / 标记器
components.role: 以发射触发为零点统计回波到达时间。
components.role_en: Histogram return arrival times relative to launch triggers.
components.note: 时间箱、抖动、死时间及堆积均影响真实分辨率与温度误差。
components.note_en: Bin size, jitter, dead time, and pile-up affect resolution and temperature error.

raman_se.title: Hausner et al. (2011). Calibrating Single-Ended Fiber-Optic Raman Spectra Distributed Temperature Sensing Data
raman_se.evidence: Open-access primary research; calibration equations and differential attenuation.

raman_de.title: van de Giesen et al. (2012). Double-Ended Calibration of Fiber-Optic Raman Spectra Distributed Temperature Sensing Data
raman_de.evidence: Open-access primary research; forward/reverse differential-attenuation correction.

raman_code.title: Park et al. (2006). Raman-based distributed temperature sensor with simplex coding and link optimization
raman_code.evidence: Author institution record and abstract; coded OTDR architecture. No performance figures copied into this atlas.

raman_count.title: Tanner et al. (2011). High-resolution single-mode fiber-optic distributed Raman sensor for absolute temperature measurement using superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors
raman_count.evidence: Primary research; full manuscript available from NIST: https://tsapps.nist.gov/publication/get_pdf.cfm?pub_id=910008

brillouin_t.title: Kurashima, Horiguchi & Tateda (1990). Distributed-temperature sensing using stimulated Brillouin scattering in optical silica fibers
brillouin_t.evidence: Primary research; Brillouin temperature sensing under controlled strain conditions.

botda.title: Horiguchi & Tateda (1989). Optical-fiber-attenuation investigation using stimulated Brillouin scattering between a pulse and a continuous wave
botda.evidence: Primary research; counter-propagating pulsed pump and CW probe.

ofdr.title: Froggatt & Moore (1998). High-spatial-resolution distributed strain measurement in optical fiber with Rayleigh scatter
ofdr.evidence: Primary research; local Rayleigh spectral cross-correlation.
